_comment: Column names inside the PUB LOG CSV distribution (FLIS Data Electronic Reading Room, CSV format since 1 Apr 2023). These are best guesses from the public layouts and the field names used in the DLA codification glossary. Run `python scripts/s01_publog_ingest.py --print-headers` against the real files and fix anything S1 reports as missing. File names are matched case-insensitively and searched recursively under PUBLOG_DIR.

spec_cage_codes._comment: CAGE codes that identify a government specification/standard rather than a manufacturer. A reference number whose CAGE is in this list is treated as the governing spec reference.
